label: PF Backlog 540
title: C8: Sandbox + Network/Egress policy for code/autonomous execution
body:
## Problem / why
Agents execute code; worktrees are not a security sandbox and there is no egress control.
## Acceptance criteria
An Execution Sandbox interface (container/VM/cloud runner) isolates generated code/commands; network egress is allowlisted (domains/repos/cloud APIs); exfiltration detected; per-deployment configurable.
